hero.title: News & Events
hero.subtitle: Stay informed with the latest updates, announcements, and events from NANS Diaspora.

featured.title: NANS Diaspora Annual Summit 2026
featured.description: The premier gathering of Nigerian student leaders from across the globe. This year's summit will focus on 'Education, Innovation, and Nigeria's Future' — featuring keynote addresses, panel discussions, and networking sessions.

articles.title: NANS Diaspora FREE MEDICAL & DENTAL MISSION OUTREACH @ NSUKKA, ENUGU STATE NIGERIA
articles.excerpt: NANS Diaspora carried out a free medical and dental mission outreach in Nsukka, Enugu State, Nigeria — providing essential healthcare services to the local community.

articles.title: NANSD Honors Ma'am Abike as GENERALISSIMO of Nigerian Students & Youths in the Diaspora
articles.excerpt: NANS Diaspora proudly honored Ma'am Abike with the title of GENERALISSIMO of Nigerian Students & Youths in the Diaspora during the National Diaspora Day Merit Awards & Dinner on 26/07/25.

articles.title: NANSD Leadership Engages Hon. Minister of Education, Federal Republic of Nigeria
articles.excerpt: On 24/07/25, the Leadership of NANS Diaspora held a strategic physical engagement with Hon. Tunji Alausa, Minister of Education. Key advocacy points included BEA scholarships, certificate racketeering in some universities and African countries, and regularization of authentication of academic documents for Nigerian students in the Diaspora.

articles.title: NANS Diaspora Annual Summit 2026 Announced
articles.excerpt: The flagship annual summit returns, bringing together chapter presidents and student leaders from across the globe.

articles.title: NANS Diaspora Scholar Wins Prestigious International Award
articles.excerpt: A member of the NANS Diaspora UK chapter has been recognised for outstanding academic and community contributions.

articles.title: NANS Diaspora Submits Memorandum to Nigerian Senate
articles.excerpt: Our leadership formally presented recommendations on student welfare, dual citizenship, and diaspora engagement.

articles.title: New Chapters Established in Southeast Asia
articles.excerpt: NANS Diaspora expands its presence with new chapters in Malaysia, Singapore, and South Korea.

articles.title: Emergency Support Fund Launched for Stranded Students
articles.excerpt: NANS Diaspora activates its emergency welfare fund to assist members affected by geopolitical disruptions.

articles.title: NANS Diaspora Signs MOU with African Development Bank
articles.excerpt: A landmark partnership to provide scholarship and mentorship opportunities for NANS Diaspora members.
